description.value: Panago is a Canadian pizza chain franchise offering delivery and takeout in Langley, BC, with an emphasis on quality ingredients including fresh-made dough from 100% Canadian wheat and no artificial colours or flavours. The chain offers an extensive plant-based, dairy-free, and meat-free menu alongside traditional pizzas, salads, and sides. A touring cyclist can expect a reliable quick-stop for hot pizza or a salad with no drive-through and takeout as the primary service model.
